bundle.shortDescription: Flake -- a local-first, offline, account-free personal knowledge and decision vault.
bundle.longDescription: Flake stores notes, evidence, decisions and actions in a local, offline, account-free vault. No cloud sync, no telemetry, no sign-in. This is a T05-03 unsigned developer release candidate (UNSIGNED_DEVELOPER_RC), not a signed final release.
